n: To thank is to name who helped. When an AI tool helps you finish a piece of work, people are still behind it: the one who taught you the job, the one who checked your draft, the ones who wrote what the tool learned from. Today, pick one piece of work you are proud of and tell one person, by name, what their part in it was. Good work has always been shared work.
